# Micah 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hear, please, what YHWH says: "Arise, contend before the-mountains, and-let-the-hills hear your-voice!"

**2** "Hear, O-mountains, the-case-of YHWH, and-you-enduring-foundations-of the-earth! For YHWH has-a-case against-His-people, and-with-Israel He-will-argue.

**3** "My-people, what have-I-done to-you? And-how have-I-wearied-you? Testify against-Me!

**4** For I-brought-you-up from-the-land-of Egypt, and-from-the-house-of slaves I-redeemed-you; and-I-sent before-you Moses, Aaron, and-Miriam.

**5** My-people, remember, please, what Balak king-of Moab counseled, and-what Balaam son-of Beor answered-him — from-Shittim to-Gilgal — so-that-you-may-know the-righteous-acts-of YHWH."

**6** "With-what shall-I-come-before YHWH, bow-myself before-God-on-high? Shall-I-come-before-Him with-burnt-offerings, with-calves sons-of-a-year?

**7** Will-YHWH be-pleased with-thousands-of rams, with-ten-thousands-of rivers-of oil? Shall-I-give my-firstborn [for]-my-transgression, the-fruit-of my-body [for]-the-sin-of my-soul?"

**8** He-has-told-you, O-man, what [is] good and-what YHWH requires of-you: only to-do justice and-to-love mercy and-to-walk-humbly with-your-God.

**9** The-voice-of YHWH to-the-city calls — and-wisdom [is to]-fear Your-name — "Hear, O-tribe and-assembly-of the-city!

**10** Are-there still in-the-house-of [the]-wicked treasures-of wickedness and-the-scant ephah [that is] accursed?

**11** Can-I-be-pure with-scales-of wickedness and-with-a-bag-of deceitful weights?

**12** For her-rich-men are-full-of violence, and-her-inhabitants speak lies, and-their-tongue [is] deceit in-their-mouth.

**13** And-also I have-made-you-sick, striking-you, desolating-[you] because-of your-sins.

**14** You will-eat and-not be-satisfied — and-emptiness [will be]-in-your-midst; and-you-will-put-aside but-not-save, and-what you-save I-will-give to-the-sword.

**15** You will-sow but-not reap; you will-tread olives but-not anoint-with oil; and-[tread]-new-wine but-not drink wine.

**16** And-kept [are] the-statutes-of Omri and-all the-work-of the-house-of Ahab, and-you-walk in-their-counsels, so-that I-may-make-you a-desolation and-her-inhabitants a-hissing; and-the-reproach-of My-people you-will-bear."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **6:3**: Mah asiti lekha — 'What have I done to you?' God as plaintiff in a covenant lawsuit (riv). The accused is invited to present counter-evidence — a stunning rhetorical move that highlights divine innocence.

- **6:8**: Asot mishpat ve-ahavat chesed ve-hatznea lekhet im-Elohekha — 'do justice, love mercy, walk humbly with your God.' The most concise summary of prophetic ethics in the Hebrew Bible. Three requirements: social (justice), relational (mercy), spiritual (humility).

- **6:6-7**: Escalating sacrificial offers: burnt offerings → yearling calves → thousands of rams → rivers of oil → firstborn child. The absurd escalation exposes the error of transactional religion.

— EMET
